<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Platform\Authz\Http;

use InvalidArgumentException;

class RouteRequirementResolver
{
    /** @var array<string, string> Map of special permission names to user method names */
    private array $specialPermissions;

    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $specialPermissions Map of special permission name => user method name
     */
    public function __construct(array $specialPermissions = [])
    {
        $this->specialPermissions = $specialPermissions;
    }

    /**
     * Resolve the requirement for a given route name.
     *
     * Reads from config('route_permissions.routes') and parses the permission
     * string into a structured RouteRequirement.
     *
     * @return RouteRequirement|null Null if route not found in config
     */
    public function resolve(string $routeName): ?RouteRequirement
    {
        $routes = config('route_permissions.routes', []);

        if (!array_key_exists($routeName, $routes)) {
            return null; // Missing mapping is handled as a fail-closed error by the middleware.
        }

        $permissionString = $routes[$routeName];

        if ($permissionString === null) {
            return new RouteRequirement(RouteRequirement::TYPE_NONE);
        }

        return $this->parse($permissionString);
    }

    /**
     * Parse a permission string into a RouteRequirement.
     *
     * Supports:
     *   - 'capability.string.scope' → TYPE_SINGLE
     *   - 'cap1 | cap2' → TYPE_ANY_OF
     *   - 'cap1 & cap2' → TYPE_ALL_OF (each part may contain | for OR)
     *   - 'system_admin_access' → TYPE_SPECIAL (if in specialPermissions map)
     */
    public function parse(string $permissionString): RouteRequirement
    {
        $permissionString = trim($permissionString);

        if ($permissionString === '__public__') {
            return new RouteRequirement(RouteRequirement::TYPE_PUBLIC);
        }

        // Check if it's a special permission
        if (isset($this->specialPermissions[$permissionString])) {
            return new RouteRequirement(
                type: RouteRequirement::TYPE_SPECIAL,
                specialMethod: $this->specialPermissions[$permissionString],
            );
        }

        // Split by '&' for AND clauses
        $andClauses = array_map('trim', explode('&', $permissionString));
        $andClauses = array_filter($andClauses, fn(string $c) => $c !== '');

        if (count($andClauses) === 0) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException(
                'Route permission expression must contain at least one capability.',
            );
        }

        if (count($andClauses) === 1) {
            // Single clause — might contain | for OR
            return $this->parseClause($andClauses[0]);
        }

        // Multiple AND clauses — each is a sub-requirement
        $subRequirements = array_map(fn(string $clause) => $this->parseClause($clause), $andClauses);

        return new RouteRequirement(
            type: RouteRequirement::TYPE_ALL_OF,
            clauses: $subRequirements,
        );
    }

    private function parseClause(string $clause): RouteRequirement
    {
        $clause = trim($clause);

        // Check if this clause is a special permission
        if (isset($this->specialPermissions[$clause])) {
            return new RouteRequirement(
                type: RouteRequirement::TYPE_SPECIAL,
                specialMethod: $this->specialPermissions[$clause],
            );
        }

        // Check for OR (|)
        $orParts = array_map('trim', explode('|', $clause));
        $orParts = array_filter($orParts, fn(string $p) => $p !== '');

        if (count($orParts) === 0) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException(
                'Route permission expression must contain at least one capability.',
            );
        }

        if (count($orParts) === 1) {
            return new RouteRequirement(
                type: RouteRequirement::TYPE_SINGLE,
                capabilities: [$orParts[0]],
            );
        }

        return new RouteRequirement(
            type: RouteRequirement::TYPE_ANY_OF,
            capabilities: $orParts,
        );
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Unit\Platform\Authz;

use InvalidArgumentException;
use Tests\TestCase;
use Platform\Authz\Http\RouteRequirement;
use Platform\Authz\Http\RouteRequirementResolver;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;

class RouteRequirementResolverTest extends TestCase
{
    private RouteRequirementResolver $resolver;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        // Initialize resolver with special permissions map
        $this->resolver = new RouteRequirementResolver([
            'system_admin_access' => 'shouldBypassTeamScope',
        ]);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function resolve_returns_null_for_unknown_route(): void
    {
        config(['route_permissions.routes' => [
            'invoices.index' => 'invoices.view.team',
        ]]);

        $result = $this->resolver->resolve('unknown.route.name');

        $this->assertNull($result);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function resolve_returns_none_for_null_permission(): void
    {
        config(['route_permissions.routes' => [
            'public.route' => null,
        ]]);

        $result = $this->resolver->resolve('public.route');

        $this->assertNotNull($result);
        $this->assertSame(RouteRequirement::TYPE_NONE, $result->type);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function resolve_returns_single_capability(): void
    {
        config(['route_permissions.routes' => [
            'invoices.index' => 'invoices.view.team',
        ]]);

        $result = $this->resolver->resolve('invoices.index');

        $this->assertNotNull($result);
        $this->assertSame(RouteRequirement::TYPE_SINGLE, $result->type);
        $this->assertSame(['invoices.view.team'], $result->capabilities);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function resolve_returns_any_of_for_or_expression(): void
    {
        config(['route_permissions.routes' => [
            'invoices.show' => 'invoices.view.team | invoices.view.own',
        ]]);

        $result = $this->resolver->resolve('invoices.show');

        $this->assertNotNull($result);
        $this->assertSame(RouteRequirement::TYPE_ANY_OF, $result->type);
        $this->assertSame(['invoices.view.team', 'invoices.view.own'], $result->capabilities);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function resolve_returns_all_of_for_and_expression(): void
    {
        config(['route_permissions.routes' => [
            'reports.export' => 'reports.view.team & reports.export.team',
        ]]);

        $result = $this->resolver->resolve('reports.export');

        $this->assertNotNull($result);
        $this->assertSame(RouteRequirement::TYPE_ALL_OF, $result->type);
        $this->assertCount(2, $result->clauses);

        // First clause should be SINGLE with 'reports.view.team'
        $this->assertSame(RouteRequirement::TYPE_SINGLE, $result->clauses[0]->type);
        $this->assertSame(['reports.view.team'], $result->clauses[0]->capabilities);

        // Second clause should be SINGLE with 'reports.export.team'
        $this->assertSame(RouteRequirement::TYPE_SINGLE, $result->clauses[1]->type);
        $this->assertSame(['reports.export.team'], $result->clauses[1]->capabilities);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function resolve_handles_mixed_and_or(): void
    {
        config(['route_permissions.routes' => [
            'admin.dashboard' => 'admin.view.global & reports.view.team | reports.view.own',
        ]]);

        $result = $this->resolver->resolve('admin.dashboard');

        $this->assertNotNull($result);
        $this->assertSame(RouteRequirement::TYPE_ALL_OF, $result->type);
        $this->assertCount(2, $result->clauses);

        // First clause should be SINGLE with 'admin.view.global'
        $this->assertSame(RouteRequirement::TYPE_SINGLE, $result->clauses[0]->type);
        $this->assertSame(['admin.view.global'], $result->clauses[0]->capabilities);

        // Second clause should be ANY_OF with 2 capabilities
        $this->assertSame(RouteRequirement::TYPE_ANY_OF, $result->clauses[1]->type);
        $this->assertSame(['reports.view.team', 'reports.view.own'], $result->clauses[1]->capabilities);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function resolve_handles_special_permission(): void
    {
        config(['route_permissions.routes' => [
            'system.settings' => 'system_admin_access',
        ]]);

        $result = $this->resolver->resolve('system.settings');

        $this->assertNotNull($result);
        $this->assertSame(RouteRequirement::TYPE_SPECIAL, $result->type);
        $this->assertSame('shouldBypassTeamScope', $result->specialMethod);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function resolve_handles_special_in_and_clause(): void
    {
        config(['route_permissions.routes' => [
            'admin.delete' => 'system_admin_access & invoices.delete.team',
        ]]);

        $result = $this->resolver->resolve('admin.delete');

        $this->assertNotNull($result);
        $this->assertSame(RouteRequirement::TYPE_ALL_OF, $result->type);
        $this->assertCount(2, $result->clauses);

        // First clause should be SPECIAL
        $this->assertSame(RouteRequirement::TYPE_SPECIAL, $result->clauses[0]->type);
        $this->assertSame('shouldBypassTeamScope', $result->clauses[0]->specialMethod);

        // Second clause should be SINGLE
        $this->assertSame(RouteRequirement::TYPE_SINGLE, $result->clauses[1]->type);
        $this->assertSame(['invoices.delete.team'], $result->clauses[1]->capabilities);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function parse_trims_whitespace(): void
    {
        $result = $this->resolver->parse('  invoices.view.team  |  invoices.view.own  ');

        $this->assertSame(RouteRequirement::TYPE_ANY_OF, $result->type);
        $this->assertSame(['invoices.view.team', 'invoices.view.own'], $result->capabilities);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function parse_empty_string_returns_none(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(InvalidArgumentException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Route permission expression must contain at least one capability.');

        $this->resolver->parse('');
    }

    #[Test]
    public function parse_handles_complex_nested_expressions(): void
    {
        // Complex: 'cap1 & cap2 | cap3 & cap4 | cap5'
        // This splits by & into: ['cap1', 'cap2 | cap3', 'cap4 | cap5']
        $result = $this->resolver->parse('cap1 & cap2 | cap3 & cap4 | cap5');

        $this->assertSame(RouteRequirement::TYPE_ALL_OF, $result->type);
        $this->assertCount(3, $result->clauses);

        // First clause: SINGLE 'cap1'
        $this->assertSame(RouteRequirement::TYPE_SINGLE, $result->clauses[0]->type);
        $this->assertSame(['cap1'], $result->clauses[0]->capabilities);

        // Second clause: ANY_OF ['cap2', 'cap3']
        $this->assertSame(RouteRequirement::TYPE_ANY_OF, $result->clauses[1]->type);
        $this->assertSame(['cap2', 'cap3'], $result->clauses[1]->capabilities);

        // Third clause: ANY_OF ['cap4', 'cap5']
        $this->assertSame(RouteRequirement::TYPE_ANY_OF, $result->clauses[2]->type);
        $this->assertSame(['cap4', 'cap5'], $result->clauses[2]->capabilities);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function parse_handles_only_whitespace_with_and_operator(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(InvalidArgumentException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Route permission expression must contain at least one capability.');

        $this->resolver->parse('  &  &  ');
    }

    #[Test]
    public function parse_handles_only_whitespace_with_or_operator(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(InvalidArgumentException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Route permission expression must contain at least one capability.');

        $this->resolver->parse('  |  |  ');
    }

    #[Test]
    public function resolve_returns_public_for_public_sentinel(): void
    {
        config(['route_permissions.routes' => [
            'healthz' => '__public__',
        ]]);

        $result = $this->resolver->resolve('healthz');

        $this->assertNotNull($result);
        $this->assertSame(RouteRequirement::TYPE_PUBLIC, $result->type);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function parse_returns_public_for_public_sentinel(): void
    {
        $result = $this->resolver->parse('__public__');

        $this->assertSame(RouteRequirement::TYPE_PUBLIC, $result->type);
    }
}
